heartbeat.title: No tests concluded this month
heartbeat.body_html: No A/B tests reached a conclusion in August, so there is no new winning learning to bank this month. That is worth being plain about: the value of the testing program is that wins are kept permanently while losses cost nothing, so the channel compounds over time as tests conclude. We will report the next banked result as soon as a test reaches significance.

narrative.html: Flows earned $46,529, up 23.2% versus July. Revenue per email delivered rose to $11.166 from $10.720, so each send worked harder than it did the month before.

Flows held 10.0% of total store revenue. Against $467,368 in all orders, the automated channel is now contributing a full tenth of everything the store sells, in line with the stronger months of the last year.

Flows are the most efficient per-email channel we run. At $11.166 per email, flows earn 32.9x what campaigns do per send ($0.339), which is why flows carry 59% of email revenue. Campaigns are the second lever we run: 5 went out this month to reach the list and keep the audience warm.

Deliverability stayed clean. Unsubscribes were 0.209% of delivered and spam complaints 0.017%, both well inside healthy ranges, which protects the inbox placement that makes the flow numbers above possible.

monthly.title_sub: Flows delivered $46,529 in August, up 23.2% on July, and held 10.0% of total store revenue.

Because it measures flows against everything the store sells, it isolates flow performance from the natural swings in overall demand, so you can see the automated channel's contribution on its own terms.

heartbeat.title: No tests concluded this month
heartbeat.body_html: No A/B tests reached a conclusion in July, so there is no new winning result to bank this cycle. That is normal within one of the most comprehensive automated flow-testing programs in the industry: tests run continuously and conclude when they reach confidence, not on a fixed calendar. The value of the program is its structure. Every win we lock in stays banked permanently and keeps earning, while a losing variant costs nothing because we simply keep the original. That asymmetry means the flows compound over time at any strike rate, and this month's steady $10.720 revenue per email reflects the wins already banked from prior cycles continuing to pay out.

narrative.html: Flow revenue rose to $37,768, up 8.3% on the prior month. Revenue per email delivered climbed from $9.869 to $10.720, so the same sends are working harder, not just going out more often.

Flows are the most efficient per-email channel we run. At $10.720 per email against $0.326 for campaigns, flows earn 32.9x more per email delivered, which is why they carry 88% of email revenue off automated, always-on sends.

Campaigns are the second lever we run alongside flows. One campaign went out this month; broadcast sends complement the automations by reaching the whole list around specific moments, while flows do the steady day-to-day earning.

Flows held 7.8% of total store revenue, in line with June's 7.9% and steady through a normal demand swing. Deliverability stayed clean, with unsubscribes at 0.216% of delivered and spam complaints at 0.016%, well inside healthy limits.

monthly.title_sub: Flows delivered $37,768 in July, up 8.3% on June, and earned more per email sent than any other channel we run.
